sources.snippet: Overview Huihui-Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-abliterated is an uncensored vision-language model created by huihui-ai through abliteration of the original Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct. The model processes both images and text to generate descriptions and answer questions about visual content, using the transformers library with PyTorch.
